bio: Looking for a unique restaurant experience? This original wine bar-tavern is run by a Galician-Neapolitan couple and has an interior that leaves no one indifferent, as it has several different areas (one of them is a suspended terrace overlooking the Ría do Porto). The menu features both Galician and Italian dishes, both of which come in generous portions designed for sharing. What should you order? Don't miss the Calamarata with fresh truffles, mushrooms, crispy cecina, and Parmigiano Reggiano. On Sundays, they also offer wonderful gourmet pizzas!...
